name: Zoomer
fix_description: In the loan function (0x72c4cff6), collateral value is calculated using instantaneous Uniswap pair reserves (getReserves). An attacker can flash-loan manipulate the pair reserves to inflate collateral value and borrow excess funds. Fix: use a time-weighted average price (TWAP) oracle or Chainlink price feed instead of spot reserves for collateral valuation.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving a Balancer flash loan, repeated deployment of helper contracts, token swaps on Uniswap, and interaction with a protocol-specific vulnerable function to extract value. While the PoC is not very long, understanding why the repeated loop and contract recreation work requires reading protocol-specific logic and DeFi flow beyond a simple access control or single-call bug.
